title: For the PH market: Updates to mandatory attributes on fresh and frozen related categories
breadcrumb: For the PH market: Updates to mandatory attributes on fresh and frozen related categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-08-09
html:
What is changing?

The PH marketplace has introduced Mandatory Attributes on Fresh and Frozen related categories starting from 2024-10-9. The following L1 categories will require the Attribute Shelf Life

Meal Kits
Seafood
Frozen Food
Mushroom
Prepared Meals
Cakes & Pies
Tofu
Sandwiches & Wraps
Ice Cream
Pizza & Focaccia
Processed Meat & Seafood
Soups & Stews
Pastries
Fruit
Vegetarian Meat Alternatives
Bread
Vegetables
Deli
Eggs
Pasta & Sauces
Meat

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to the local and cross-border sellers in the PH market

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without this mandatory attribute sellers will not be able to create and update products. Use the Get Attributes to check what attributes are mandatory and pass attribute values via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers fill in the attribute values.
